edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “Spain’s 350-seat Parliament started its session at 11 a.m.”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “the majority of the 350-seat lower house of parliament”.

On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “The measures were intended to quell a public uproar following the televised eviction of an 87-year-old woman last week in Madrid that sparked protests”; on the same day, France 24 reported “two government housing decrees drawn up after an outcry over the eviction of an 87-year-old woman”.

On 2026-10-02, BBC reported “MPs rejected the first decree by 178 votes to 172”; on the same day, Reuters reported “lawmakers voted down the minority government's decree that had been drawn up to address mass anger over the eviction of an 87-year-old woman.”.
On 2026-10-02, BBC reported “voted against the second by 184 to 166.”; on the same day, Reuters reported “A second decree proposing automatic and indefinite renewal of rental contracts also failed.”.
